title: Proud Young Boy Scout in Jodhpurs Uniform, 1930s Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length outdoor portrait captures a smiling young Boy Scout standing by the exterior stucco wall of a residence next to a tall window and garden shrubbery. He proudly wears a full interwar-era Boy Scouts of America uniform, consisting of a traditional wide-brim campaign hat, a dark neckerchief held by a slide, a collared uniform shirt with buttoned flap pockets, flared riding-style breeches (jodhpurs), and tall ribbed knee socks. The image reflects early-to-mid 20th-century American youth culture, when the Boy Scouts promoted outdoor skills, civic responsibility, and moral character.
